architecture.title: System architecture
architecture.description: An authenticated browser uses one Next.js application. Pure rules and SQL adapters keep money and persistence separate.

nodes.title: HR browser
nodes.body: Workspace UI; only bounded pages and aggregate series

nodes.title: Next.js boundary
nodes.body: Evaluator session, origin checks, Zod validation

nodes.title: Domain + query modules
nodes.body: Exact money/use case; parameterized Drizzle reads and versioned writes

nodes.title: PostgreSQL
nodes.body: Persistent relational data, constraints and purpose marker

model.title: Relational model
model.description: Four reference tables connect to employees. The singleton environment marker independently guards which database an operation may use.

nodes.title: employees
nodes.body: id PK; employee_number UNIQUE; salary_minor BIGINT; period annual; version; updated_at/by

nodes.title: countries
nodes.body: employees.country → countries.code

nodes.title: currencies
nodes.body: employees.currency → currencies.code; explicit precision 0–3

nodes.title: departments
nodes.body: employees.department → departments.id

nodes.title: roles
nodes.body: employees.role → roles.id

nodes.title: salary_desk_environment
nodes.body: Singleton purpose; not an employee foreign key

salary.title: Salary-update sequence
salary.description: A confirmed save and a conflict are separate outcomes. Failed or uncertain saves preserve input; they do not show success.

nodes.title: 1 · Browser draft
nodes.body: Amount + currency + annual period + expected version

nodes.title: 2 · API and domain
nodes.body: Session/origin, validated JSON, exact decimal parsing

nodes.title: 3 · Conditional SQL
nodes.body: UPDATE WHERE id AND version; increment version and server metadata

nodes.title: 4 · Outcome
nodes.body: 200: confirmed current salary · 409: review newer version · failure: keep draft

nodes.title: 5 · Refresh views
nodes.body: Retain confirmed detail; invalidate pages, analyses and Dashboard

cache.title: Read, cache and invalidation
cache.description: Memory reuse belongs to one authenticated browser scope. HTTP responses remain private/no-store and all fetches still require access.

nodes.title: URL → exact query key
nodes.body: Population, sort, page/page size, currency and access scope

nodes.title: Fresh memory entry
nodes.body: Return promptly; no forced skeleton or bulk page prefetch

nodes.title: Visible stale or uncached
nodes.body: Deduplicate request; authenticated API → purpose check → PostgreSQL

nodes.title: Accepted response
nodes.body: Correct key only; changed chart values update in place

nodes.title: Edit / sign-out
nodes.body: Edit invalidates salary keys and other tabs; sign-out/401 clears memory

timeline.title: Recorded development progression
timeline.description: Commits are real milestones, not a reconstructed test-first story. Public baseline commits link to GitHub; review-only commits remain explicitly unpublished.
